# Sellio

> Sellio is an online storefront and ordering platform for food and drink businesses, shops and home sellers in Singapore, Malaysia and Indonesia, made by Apptelier in Singapore. Businesses get a branded storefront, QR and table ordering, a POS counter, a kitchen display, inventory, reports and staff roles. Anyone can browse Sellio's shops and their items on Sellio Explore and order straight from the shop.

Website: https://sellio.sg/
Made by: Apptelier, Singapore (https://apptelier.sg/)
Contact: sellio@apptelier.sg
Sales, multi-outlet and setup enquiries: WhatsApp +65 8222 8103 (https://wa.me/6582228103)
Android app: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.base6985959ce9aaceadb8b7cc41.app

## How ordering works

- Each shop has its own storefront at https://sellio.sg/store/<shop>, with its items and prices, and where it says so its opening hours and how it sells (self-collection, delivery, pre-orders, dine-in by table QR code).
- Each item listed on Explore has its own page at https://sellio.sg/listing/<item>, with its price, photos, description and options.
- Customers order straight from the shop's storefront. On the web and at a shop's tables they don't need an account; in the Sellio app they sign in first.
- Shops set their own prices, in Singapore dollars (S$), ringgit (RM) or rupiah (Rp).

## For businesses

Plans, in Singapore dollars:

- Starter: S$39 a month or S$390 a year. 10 products, up to 100 orders a month, 3 staff accounts, 5 tables and QR codes, POS counter, QR ordering and storefront, kitchen display and receipt printing, basic reports, Sellio AI tools.
- Growth: S$79 a month or S$790 a year. Everything in Starter, plus 50 products, up to 1,000 orders a month, 5 staff accounts, advanced reports, custom editable roles, email and chat support.
- Professional: S$119 a month or S$1,190 a year. Everything in Growth, plus unlimited products, orders, staff accounts, tables and QR codes, custom real-time reports, unlimited custom roles and priority support.
- New business sign-ups get a seven-day free trial.
- Businesses in Indonesia: S$18, S$35 and S$56 a month (Starter, Growth, Professional), charged in rupiah.
- Selling from home: a free personal shop, with up to 10 listings and 100 orders a month.
- Done-for-you setup: S$149 one-time (menu scan, storefront build, printer setup and on-site staff training).
- More than one outlet: talk to Sellio on WhatsApp.

The plans and prices on https://sellio.sg/ are the source of truth.

## Key terms

- Storefront: a shop's own branded ordering page on Sellio.
- Sellio Explore: Sellio's public feed of shops, home sellers and their items.
- Home seller: someone selling from home on a free personal shop.
- Sellio World: a marketplace map where shops get a place in an F&B, Retail or Services district; coming soon.
- Sellio Coins: rewards planned with Sellio World, for cosmetic storefront upgrades.

## Not public

Sign-in pages, a shop's workspace (orders, kitchen display, products, reports, staff), order pages and previews of a storefront are not public pages and are not documentation of Sellio.
